user.title: Track this Home Assistant connection
user.description: Look up the public IP used by this Home Assistant server through IPWhois. The service sees your outgoing public IP. Location is approximate network geolocation, not RV GPS. Polls every 5 minutes by default. No API key is needed.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve valid lookup data. Check internet access and try later.
error.rate_limited: IPWhois rate limit reached. Wait for the provider quota to reset before retrying.

abort.already_configured: The current internet connection is already configured.

init.title: Polling settings
init.description: One request updates all entities. 300 seconds is 288 requests/day. Shared public IPs may share the provider quota.
